name: motion-drag-lift
title: Drag Pickup
description: Con trỏ nhấn giữ, thẻ nhấc lên phóng nhẹ 1.045 và bóng đổ sâu hơn, được kéo đi rồi thả về, đặt xuống trong 0.18 s.

moworks.author: moworks

options.tile: index of the tile picked up (1)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Grid card 240x140 with six tiles 60x48 r10 (74 / 62 px pitch); the accent tile is grabbed at 0.5 s: lift L = spring(k420, c30): scale 1 + 0.045 L, shadow blur 8 → 28 px, offset y 2 → 12 px, opacity 0.55 → 0.7; a dashed ghost stays at its slot. Held, it is dragged +26, −10 px (0.6-1.05 s power2.inOut) and back (1.05-1.55 s). Release at 1.8 s: L → 0 over 180 ms power2.out. Params: lift (1.045) · shadow (8 → 28 px) · spring (k420 c30) · settle (0.18 s). Lifted: scale 1 + 0.045 L, shadow blur 8 → 28, offset 2 → 12; a dashed ghost keeps its slot.
moworks.titleVi: Nhấc thẻ lên khi bắt đầu kéo
